open_items: 18.k.R/C retain adversarial original/provenance binding, actual process-loss recovery and byte-identical cleanup acceptance; each has its own Apply gate.

oracle.apply_expected: An approved currently qualified exact inner plan publishes together with one applied Proposal control revision and native receipt; stale/unqualified inputs do not change normative bytes. Dry-run and confirmed replay perform no new normative write. Audit lists actual bound identities and safe observed input; historical evidence never creates authority.
oracle.expected: Each explicit review creates exactly one physical revision with identical content revision/hash, basis and plan. Before quorum status remains in_review with no artificial self-transition; distinct effective human actors reach approved. Repetition cannot add a human, AI/CI are refused, current provenance is reobserved, and pre-publication failures leave the Proposal unchanged. Human input alone supplies the decision, never a technical detector.
oracle.negative_review_expected: Only explicit human negative decisions change control history with one physical revision and stable content binding. Unproven/foreign/old decisions cannot authorize withdrawal. Withdrawn, outdated or externally ineffective reviews never become a new approval; native write failures retain real evidence.
oracle.negative_review_scope: 18.j negative decisions and own withdrawal through the existing native writer, retained history and read-only qualification; no public 18.k Apply or release gate is claimed.
oracle.requirement_contract: `specroad proposal apply <FILE>` MUSS mindestens die konfigurierte Anzahl gültiger menschlicher Freigaben nach dem Inhaltsbindungsvertrag aus Kapitel 10.3 und 11.10 verlangen.
oracle.scope: Native public 18.k Proposal Apply and existing shared writer/recovery on the configured supported Linux environment; all runtime evidence is supplied by each actual Apply gate.

preconditions: Use an owned complete small native project with configured human quorum, actual review-start transaction, complete retained original contexts and an explicitly synthetic host verifier.
18.j uses isolated small complete native projects, actual original revisions and synthetic host provenance/authority, never inferred human approval.

Current approved managed Proposal with complete actual original/review contexts, unchanged specification basis and explicit synthetic host provenance/authority. Native isolated project, not an application service or production approval.
steps: Invoke the native proposal review writer with an explicit human decision and optional comment, retaining content binding and every prior history row.
Observe distinct human actor_ids reaching the configured quorum, an insufficient count remaining in_review, original canonical assessment bytes and actual writer completion.
Compare public argv and structured request under the same explicit host context; dry-run preserves normative files, journal and receipt inventory.
Repeat a human decision and reject AI/CI review calls, including dry-run; stale or revoked host evidence does not fill the quorum.

Perform explicit negative human decisions through native proposal review; compare full original content binding, retained history, exact revision and actual completion.
Withdraw only the same human approval: in_review keeps status, approved becomes rejected; reject foreign/nonhuman/absent approvals and require an explicit withdrawal reason.
Compare public argv and structured requests, including dry-run with unchanged project/journal/receipt inventory.
Check real request replay/conflicts, original-row and v1/v2 tampering, current authority loss and retained interrupted-staging journal.

Invoke the native Proposal Apply writer and public argv/structured entrypoints; compare exact inner results, actor/time, IDs, single applied control revision and real durable completion.
Require the configured distinct-human quorum and current original binding; reject changed basis/revision, ineffective approval and missing authority without rewriting the Proposal.
Compare dry-run and audit against the complete project inventory; preserve unrelated files and generate no Git or project execution.
